compiled_state.title: T2: RED — Implement bypass-log-check.sh enforcement gate
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Goal
Create plugins/dso/scripts/bypass-log-check.sh that validates bypass log entries are present when a gate override occurs and are included in the artifact bundle.

## Files to Create
- plugins/dso/scripts/bypass-log-check.sh

## Logic
- Reads gate override events from artifact bundle JSON
- For each override entry: checks presence of bypass_log sub-object with {rationale: string, caller_context: string}
- Missing bypass_log or missing fields -> exits 1 with JSON error {override_gate, missing_field}
- All overrides have valid bypass_log -> exits 0

## Acceptance Criteria
- chmod +x plugins/dso/scripts/bypass-log-check.sh
- bash tests/scripts/test-bypass-log-enforcement.sh exits 0 (all 6 cases GREEN)

## Testing Mode
RED (depends S6/T1)
